answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded nectar. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. That makes each attestation permanently attributable: a canyon that vouched for junk is a timestamped record the audit lanes can act on later. So a kernel of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal s6d5s.
